description:
Does Adam Savage think modern digital effects are as good as practical? When birds fly does the Earth weigh the same? Is there a chance Adam and Jamie were punked by the "Are Elephants Scared of Mice" elephants? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members TaliesinSmith, mark-c9g and allochthonplays2978, whom we thank for their support. Do you think Jamie and Adam were punked?
